description:
Java JNI bindings for supranational/blst — a BLS12-381 signature library
    that is fast, secure, and has no external dependencies. Used by the
    DecentralChain node for BLS-based threshold signatures and zkSNARK
    verifier operations.
    Forked from Decentral-America/blst (upstream supranational/blst v0.3.16)
    with full upstream history and DCC production hardening.
